name: agent-edit-banner
title: Agent Edit Banner
description: The strip under a document's header after an agent changed it: the agent's purple bot, "Edited by Claude (via Manoj) · 3 changes · 2m ago", View changes, Undo and a dismiss — with the undoing, refused, created and read-only states and the other agents behind +N.

meta.whenToUse: Pinned under a page's header after an agent edited or created it, so people can see the change and undo it.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent asking before it acts (RequestCard), a transient result after the viewer's own action (Toast), or a page-wide notice (AnnouncementBanner).
